name: Kincaid Park
coordNote: Kincaid Park Chalet, 6998 Raspberry Rd (Nominatim)
groomedBy: NSAA (Nordic Skiing Association of Anchorage), Muni park
grooming: Daily or near-daily in season, track-set plus skate lane; snowmaking loop opened early (track-packing began 7 Nov last season). Reports: Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Kincaid; NSAA live map maps.ancgis.com/AGOL_NordicTrails; Kincaid webcam
lit: ~19-24 km (12-15 mi) lit: Mize, Margeaux's, Jodphur, Lekisch, most of snowmaking loop; hours ? (Raspberry Rd gate locks ~10 pm)
dogs: No on groomed ski trails in winter
highlights: Anchorage's premier venue: rolling forest and sand-dune terrain, stadium, biathlon range and moose. Snowmaking plus lights make it the most reliable in-town option for a dark, thin-snow late December.

name: Hillside Trails (Service High / Hilltop, incl. Spencer Loop)
coordNote: Hilltop Ski Area; main ski lot is 7011 Abbott Rd just west. Alt: Service High 61.139274,-149.781685; South Bivouac TH (Spencer) 61.153184,-149.737764
grooming: Regular in season, track-set + skate. Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Hillside; NSAA live map
km: ~25-37 (alaska.org 25+; Nordic Pulse 37.5 incl. Tour of Anchorage and multi-use; Spencer 6.8)
dogs: No on ski-only loops (multi-use corridors allow leashed dogs)
highlights: Hilly, wooded trails in the foothills; Spencer Loop has the city's biggest climb ('Wall Street'). Higher than Kincaid, so it often holds snow a little better, and the lit loops work after the ~3:45 pm sunset.

name: Far North Bicentennial Park / Tour of Anchorage trail
coordNote: Campbell Airstrip Trailhead (Nominatim)
grooming: Tour of Anchorage route groomed regularly; NSAA live map
km: ? (Tour of Anchorage segment ~7.8 km on Nordic Pulse Hillside; park has ~100 mi of mixed trails)
lit: No (except where it joins Hillside lit loops)
dogs: Leashed on multi-use; some trails mushing-only in winter
highlights: A 4,000-acre forest park linking Hillside, Campbell Tract and Chugach SP, good for long point-to-point skis. Expect moose.

name: BLM Campbell Tract (Campbell Creek Science Center)
coordNote: Campbell Creek Science Center, 5600 Science Center Dr. Smokejumper TH off Elmore Rd not in OSM
grooming: Viewpoint, Old Rondy, Birch Knob and Coyote get tracks 'when conditions allow'; frequency ?
dogs: Leash required (BLM cites); stay off signed winter mushing trails
highlights: Quiet federal forest tract between FNBP and Hillside, with groomed classic/skate trails and dedicated sled-dog trails.

name: Russian Jack Springs Park
coordNote: Lidia Selkregg Chalet, 1600 Lidia Selkregg Ln (Nominatim)
groomedBy: Muni Parks & Rec (NSAA on race days)
grooming: Regular in season; signed classic-only but skating common on south fairways; north forest loop classic
lit: Most main groomed trails lit (golf-course loops); north woods unlit; hours ?
highlights: Close-in, mostly lit golf-course and forest loops, good for beginners and a quick evening ski. Lit link south to APU and Chester Creek.

name: APU / UAA / Goose Lake (Jim Mahaffey trails)
coordNote: Goose Lake Park lot (Nominatim). APU campus 61.191534,-149.800786
groomedBy: NSAA with APU; Goose Loop by Muni Parks + UAA
grooming: APU: 5 km groomed; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/NSAA-APU
lit: APU loops ?; adjoining Chester Creek trunk lit
highlights: Flat, easy campus-reserve loops and the hub for cross-city tours. APU rents classic and skate skis.

name: Lanie Fleischer Chester Creek Trail
coordNote: Westchester Lagoon (west end; Nominatim). East end Goose Lake Park 61.195138,-149.821073
grooming: Track-set + skate lane once snow allows; Muni weekly Winter Ice & Trail Conditions report and live grooming map
lit: Yes, lit the whole trunk (~6.4 km); hours ?
highlights: Lit greenbelt across midtown via tunnels, connecting Coastal Trail, Goose Lake, APU and Russian Jack. Easy in-town lit skiing, though busy with walkers.

name: Tony Knowles Coastal Trail
coordNote: Elderberry Park trailhead, downtown (Nominatim)
grooming: Groomed once regular grooming starts; less consistent than Kincaid/Chester; Muni report
highlights: Flat, scenic ski along Cook Inlet from downtown to Kincaid, with views of Denali, Sleeping Lady and ice floes. Exposed to wind, and coastal snow is often thin or icy.

name: Campbell Creek Trail (greenbelt)
coordNote: Campbell Creek Greenbelt (Nominatim, approx; mid-trail). Taku Lake Park 61.148957,-149.882564
grooming: Occasional; northern half often well groomed; Muni report
km: ~12 (7.5 mi, University Lake to W Dimond)
highlights: Leisurely greenbelt through midtown that connects to Chester Creek and FNBP. Good for a long, easy tour.

name: Ship Creek Trail
coordNote: Ship Creek Trail (Nominatim, mid-trail)
highlights: Downtown paved path that Visit Anchorage says suits skiing in winter. Low priority; grooming unverified.

name: Bartlett High School trails
coordNote: Bartlett High School (Nominatim)
grooming: Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Bartlett
highlights: Hilly, twisty high-school race loops in mature forest along the JBER boundary.

name: Connors Bog (skijoring)
coordNote: Connors Bog Dog Park (Nominatim)
grooming: Groomed for skijoring; frequency ?
dogs: Yes when skijoring; off-leash dogs must stay off groomed trails
highlights: Muni-designated multi-use and skijor area; the dog-friendly option if skiing with a dog.

name: Glen Alps / Upper Huffman (Chugach State Park)
coordNote: Glen Alps Trailhead (Nominatim)
grooming: 'When time and resources permit'; groomed 23-24 Oct 2026 for skate; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Upper-Huffman-Glen-Alps
km: Up to ~24 when fully groomed; often much less
dogs: Leashed in lot, under control on trails
highlights: About 2,200 ft, with the earliest and most reliable groomed snow near town and big views. Steep, icy access road; above-treeline wind and avalanche terrain nearby.

name: Powerline Pass Trail
coordNote: Uses Glen Alps Trailhead
grooming: Irregular; see Glen Alps report
highlights: Wide utility-corridor valley, gentle until a steep top; the upper valley is avalanche-prone. Check CNFAIC Chugach State Park zone.

name: Prospect Heights (Middle Fork, Gasline, Wolverine)
coordNote: Prospect Heights Trailhead (Nominatim)
grooming: Ungroomed / user-packed
highlights: Web of packed multi-use trails into Chugach SP that connect to Powerline and Glen Alps; fat bikes share them.

name: Rabbit Lake / McHugh Lake
coordNote: Rabbit Lake Trailhead, end of Canyon Rd (Nominatim)
grooming: Ungroomed
highlights: Ski tour into a bowl below the Suicide Peaks. Avalanche terrain; Canyon Rd is rough and needs 4WD.

name: Beach Lake Park Nordic Trails
coordNote: Beach Lake Chalet (Nominatim)
groomedBy: NSAA under contract with Eagle River/Chugiak Parks & Rec
grooming: Regular in season; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Beach-Lake
dogs: ? on ski trails; stay off adjacent mushing-only trails (1 Aug-15 Apr)
highlights: The largest groomed and lit system north of town, with steep headwalls and race loops. Low elevation, so cover varies by year.

name: Coyote Trails at Mirror Lake Middle School
coordNote: Mirror Lake Middle School (Nominatim)
grooming: In season; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Mirror-Lake
highlights: Compact forest loops behind the school, easy to moderate.

name: Edmonds Lake / Mirror Lake loops (ungroomed)
coordNote: Edmonds Lake (Nominatim; lake centroid, approx trailhead)
grooming: Ungroomed
highlights: Ungroomed single track and lake skiing; only go out once the ice is safe.

name: Eagle River High School loops
coordNote: Eagle River High School (Nominatim)
grooming: When snow allows; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/NSAA-Eagle-River
highlights: Short loops above the Eagle River canyon that connect to the snowbound Chugach SP campground roads.

name: Eagle River Nature Center (Rodak, Albert Loop, Iditarod/Crow Pass)
coordNote: Eagle River Nature Center, 32750 Eagle River Rd (Nominatim)
grooming: Rodak and Albert Loop groomed/packed for XC; frequency ?; ernc.org/current-trail-conditions
highlights: Mountain-valley touring in Chugach SP, not track skiing. Albert Loop has seasonal bear closures (usually reopens early Nov).

name: Eklutna Lake / Lakeside Trail
coordNote: Eklutna Lake Campground (Nominatim); day-use lot adjacent
grooming: Ungroomed; snowmachines allowed once State Parks opens it
highlights: Flat, huge-scenery touring along a glacial lake, shared with snowmachines. No cell signal; lake ice is unreliable.

name: Government Peak Recreation Area
coordNote: approx: GPRA area polygon (Nominatim). Chalet: 10690 N Mountain Trails Dr, Palmer (not in OSM)
groomedBy: Mat-Su Ski Club volunteers (Mat-Su Borough venue)
grooming: Regular in season; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Matsu; matsuski.org/mssc-trail-report; trail cams
lit: ~6.5 km (MSSC); gate open 8 am-9 pm in winter; light hours ?
dogs: Not on ski trails; leashed on multi-use Pioneer Loop
fee: Mat-Su Borough parking pass (~$5/day, current price ?)
highlights: The Mat-Su's main Nordic center, with a heated chalet, rentals and lit loops at the foot of Hatcher Pass. Lower than Hatcher, so the December base can be thin.

name: Independence Mine / Gold Cord Road (Hatcher Pass)
coordNote: approx: Independence Mine SHP boundary (Nominatim); winter parking is the lower lot by the A-frames ~MP 17
groomedBy: Mat-Su Ski Club under State Parks permit
grooming: Usually Southcentral's earliest grooming (Oct-Nov). 2026-27 UNCERTAIN: permit amended late Oct 2026 and a landowner plans to plow half of Gold Cord Rd. Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Matsu-Mine
highlights: At ~3,450-3,550 ft it has the most reliable December snow near Anchorage. Avalanche terrain above; check hpavalanche.org. No lights and very short daylight.

name: Archangel Road (Hatcher Pass)
coordNote: approx: Archangel Rd near Hatcher Pass Rd junction (Nominatim)
grooming: First ~4 km, sometimes 8 km; 2026-27 approval pending; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Matsu-Archangel
highlights: Unplowed, non-motorized valley road below the Talkeetna Mountains. Lined by avalanche paths; check HPAC.

name: Matanuska Moose Range (Wendt Rd)
coordNote: approx: Wendt Rd (Nominatim), trailhead at road end
grooming: Periodic; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Matsu-Moose
highlights: Big rolling forest-and-swamp network; low and wind-exposed.

name: Crevasse-Moraine Trail System
coordNote: approx: Crevasse-Moraine trail (Nominatim); MSB gives TH 61.5919,-149.1928
grooming: When snow is ample; MSB Winter Trail Grooming map
highlights: Steep kettle-and-moraine terrain, the original Mat-Su Ski Club venue. Low elevation.

name: Lazy Mountain winter trails
coordNote: approx: Lazy Mountain Trail (Nominatim); MSB TH 61.6113,-149.0160
grooming: ? (unverified)
highlights: Minor venue; go only if confirmed groomed.

name: Matanuska Lakes State Recreation Area
coordNote: SRA (Nominatim)
highlights: Lakes-and-forest trails next to Crevasse-Moraine; skiable with enough snow.

name: Nancy Lake State Recreation Area
coordNote: approx: SRA (Nominatim); winter trailhead is MP 2.2 Nancy Lake Pkwy
grooming: Listed by MSB as groomed; frequency ?
highlights: Flat lake-and-forest touring with public-use cabins; usually cold, steady snow.

name: Girdwood Nordic Ski Club network (Moose Meadows, Stumpy's, Beaver Pond, Lower Iditarod)
coordNote: approx: girdwood.com coords (not in Nominatim); Moose Meadows TH, Arlberg Ave by soccer fields
grooming: When freezing and snowpack allow; Moose Meadow track-set; Nordic Pulse nordic-pulse.com/ski-areas/US/AK/Girdwood-Nordic; skigirdwood.org
dogs: Allowed on multi-use/Moose Meadows (stay out of classic track)
highlights: Flat, dog-friendly meadows under Mt. Alyeska. Far more snow than Anchorage, but rain-on-snow can pull grooming.

name: Girdwood 5K Nordic Loop
coordNote: approx: girdwood.com coords, end of Arlberg Ave past Hotel Alyeska (hotel 60.970271,-149.098662 Nominatim)
grooming: Club priority trail; Nordic Pulse Girdwood-Nordic
fee: Free; small lot, overflow at Alyeska Lot A
highlights: Best groomed skate skiing south of Anchorage: hilly, purpose-built. Rentals at Hotel Alyeska, and the Alyeska Nordic Spa next door.

name: Alyeska Multi-Use Pathway
coordNote: approx: Alyeska Hwy (Nominatim)
grooming: None
highlights: The only lit trail in Girdwood, but usually plowed, so it is skiable only right after storms.

name: Bird Valley (Chugach State Park)
coordNote: approx: Konikson Rd (Nominatim); TH at road end
grooming: Irregular
highlights: Quiet rainforest valley touring. Cross the Penguin Peak avalanche path quickly and watch for creek overflow.

name: Indian Valley Trail
coordNote: Indian Valley Trailhead (Nominatim)
grooming: Ungroomed
highlights: South end of the Powerline Pass traverse. Mid-winter means trail breaking and short days.

name: Turnagain Pass (Chugach NF, non-motorized east side)
coordNote: approx: pass point (Nominatim); Center Ridge lot/restrooms at MP 68.5 east side
grooming: Ungroomed (occasional skate on crust)
km: Turnagain Pass Trail (INHT) ~10 km each way
highlights: The most reliable December snow in Southcentral (Center Ridge SNOTEL: Dec 1 median 26.5 in, Jan 1 57 in). Serious avalanche terrain; read the CNFAIC forecast. West side (Seattle Ridge) is motorized.

name: Johnson Pass North Trailhead (INHT)
coordNote: Johnson Pass Trailhead (Nominatim)
grooming: Ungroomed
km: ~6.4 easy to Bench Creek (37 km total)
highlights: Easy valley touring near Turnagain's snowpack; avalanche paths farther in; lot may be unplowed.

name: Cooper Landing Nordic Ski Club trails (Devils Creek, Russian River CG, Quartz Creek)
coordNote: approx: Russian River Campground (Nominatim); Devils Creek TH Seward Hwy MP 39 not geocoded
groomedBy: Cooper Landing Nordic Ski Club volunteers
grooming: Irregular; grooming.cooperlandingnordicskiclub.org (site down) and Facebook CLNSC
highlights: Volunteer classic tracks in the Kenai mountains. Devils Creek is higher and holds snow longest.

name: Trail River Campground loops (Moose Pass)
coordNote: Trail River Campground (Nominatim)
grooming: 'Most campground loops groomed'; frequency ?
highlights: Flat forest and river loops.

name: Seward Nordic Ski Club: Divide Ski Area (Mile 12)
coordNote: approx: 'Divide' railroad siding near Seward Hwy MP 12 (Nominatim)
grooming: sewardnordicskiclub.org/trails and Facebook; frequency ?
lit: No (annual New Year's Eve candlelit Luminary Ski; 2026 date ?)
highlights: Seward's main Nordic venue; the Dec 31 luminary ski falls inside the trip.

name: Exit Glacier Road (Kenai Fjords NP)
coordNote: approx: Herman Leirer Rd near Windsong Lodge (Nominatim); winter gate nearby
grooming: Ungroomed road ski
highlights: Car-free road to a glacier with a day-use warming hut. Snowmachines once NPS declares enough snow.

name: Resurrection Pass Trail North (Hope)
coordNote: Resurrection Pass Trailhead (Nominatim); last mile of road unplowed
grooming: Ungroomed
highlights: Long backcountry route; 2026-27 should be the non-motorized winter (odd/even rule, confirm with Seward RD).

name: Yosemite Drive Trails
coordNote: centre of the groomed loops (MOA layer)
grooming: NSAA, track-set; live status on the MOA grooming map
highlights: Small lit, ski-only loop system in Eagle River, groomed by NSAA. Found in the Municipality's official grooming layer.
